title: Hollywood Boat Rentals
specs: Top-rated operators across Hollywood and Fort Lauderdale
Quality rental boats from pontoons to mega yachts
Year-round operation on South Florida's waterways
Must be at least 18 years old with valid photo ID to rent a boat or jet ski; some operators require 19
Florida Boating Safety Education ID Card required if born on or after January 1, 1988 to operate motorized vessel
No prior boating experience required; safety briefing and basic instruction provided for self-drive boats
includes: Instructions on operating the boat and GPS guidance for self-drive rentals
Stewardess, light bites, beverages, and fuel for yacht charters
gap: Exact price ranges for different boat types and yacht sizes not stated
blurb: Guests can captain their own rental boats with instruction and GPS guidance, or choose rentals with a licensed captain for guided tours. Luxury yacht charters include a captain, stewardess, light bites, beverages, and fuel for local cruising. Rentals range from 2 to 8 hours, with half-day, full-day, and extended trip options for yachts.
extraNote: Cancellation and refund policies vary; most offer free cancellation up to 24–48 hours before scheduled time · Trips rescheduled or refunded if weather conditions are unsafe; light rain does not cancel trips · Year-round
